odc_type: precision loss due to floating-point arithmetic
observation_summary: The factorial function returned incorrect values for inputs n >= 17 due to floating-point rounding errors.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by calculating factorials using floating-point operations (logarithms and exponentiation) for values that should be represented exactly as integers. For n >= 17, the precision limitations of double-precision floating-point numbers led to rounding errors, causing the result to deviate from the correct integer value. The fix replaces these floating-point calculations with exact integer multiplication for n <= 20, ensuring accuracy for all values that fit within a 64-bit long.
